text_block_list.text:
Having raced through her first three years 
in the Twinkle Series, 
Phalaenopsis was currently—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... 
It seems I still fall short of who I was 
in days gone by.

Facing the reality that every athlete must 
eventually confront: 
her "peak out."
choice_data_list:
—Still, with this time, you'll be just 
fine.

text_block_list.text:
She had undeniably declined. I could 
understand why the public considered 
her victory over Mejiro Dober in the Queen 
Elizabeth II Commemorative Cup 
to have been the pinnacle of her career.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. 
I share that very sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even if the clock runs slower. 
—I am at my strongest right now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Watch over me to the very end, Trainer. 
Even as I pass my prime and wither away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even as my strength fades, my stamina 
wanes, 
and I grit my teeth as rising stars 
overtake me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even as I cling stubbornly and 
ungracefully to the turf, 
without harboring the faintest hint of 
resignation.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —For that is who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Phalaeno-chan! 
Looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Lady Fine Motion. A horse girl of noble 
blood who 
came from Ireland to study abroad. A 
formidable champion who 
claimed victory in the Shuka Sho with 
undeniable skill.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Pleased to face you. 
I shall meet you with the entirety of my 
power.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, there is only one throne. 
I must ask that you remain standing today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪ Of course! 
I came fully prepared!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Prepared to be crowned 
as the new queen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. You jest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(However, she is not the only one 
who warrants my vigilance—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I will not lose. 
Because this is all I have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It can only be found there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Lady Admire Groove. A blue-silver blossom 
who keeps 
others at bay, directing a harsh gaze upon 
herself 
as she strides forward.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And above all, today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while. —I'm here to take it 
back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I left it in your care for a while, 
Phalaeno. 
But I think it's time to bring it home to 
the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm going to beat you, strong as 
you are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. 
I accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: As the reigning queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—The Club's future has been forged. 
The flame of the next generation has been 
lit. Therefore...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I could simply walk now. It would be fine 
even if I stopped. 
There are those who would say as much. I 
am well aware.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yet, I cannot permit it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To abdicate the queen's throne of my own 
will and flee— 
—I will not permit it, not even in death.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Until that day comes when my Trainer and I 
agree—that this is the end. 
Until we bring our strides to a halt in 
mutual accord.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—As the queen, I shall fight tooth and 
nail.
